_rule: The cell gauge's marks, the single source the chain's report draws from (2026-10-13, author: 'placing it back in the report will help you remember'). Every value must match the book's gauge table, docs/book/part6/p6_06_gauge.tex, where the full surface is computed by verify_book.py; CANON/status_check.py refuses a mismatch. The DIRECTION is CANON/foundation.json entry gauge_direction, remembered by the black hole: right is over-writing toward the full surface; left of Normal is more order than healthy; below the floor identity can no longer be held.

floor.book_anchor: is at $1\times10^{-7}$ on the Met-A row and $1$--$2\times10^{-8}$ on the IAM-A row (the sample's own), off the left edge
floor.label: floor H_min: the least writing an X cell can run on (one ATP against thermal kicks). Below it the bit rate is too low to maintain the cell

normal.label: Normal: the cell working as itself

breach.label: breach: to be measured, from tumor/normal pairs, the DNMT1-inhibitor series and blood cancers

full_surface.label: full surface: every identity site at a coin flip - the 2D surface is full and past it the reading turns over
full_surface.IAM-A_rule: IAM-A reads each sample against its own line, A = eps/eps_pred(L), so its ends are the sample's own: the full surface is the held error at a coin flip, A = 0.5/eps_pred(L) (12.41 at L = 0, 6.68 at L = 1), and the floor is 1/(1+e^M) = 8.06e-10 over eps_pred(L) (2.0e-8 to 1.1e-8). The report draws them per sample. 4.26 and 1e-7 were the retired position form's ends (2026-10-17).

left_region: less writing than healthy (senescence reads here)
right_region: more and more writing toward the full surface: the black hole side, where cancer sits

normal_by_instrument._note: IAM-A: band v1 (COM-IAMA-054, sealed 2026-10-16; commissioned 2026-10-17, Runtime Matrices/IAM_A_SelfRef/band_v1.json). Met-A's band is not borrowed (author 2026-10-15). A band is drawn only where it was measured.

reading: The gauge reads the writing on the cell's 2D surface, in bits: less writing to the left, more to the right.
Left end, the floor (H_min): the least writing an X cell can run on. Below it the bit rate is too low to maintain the X cell. Derived: one full ATP per site against thermal kicks.
Left of healthy: less writing than healthy cells. Senescence reads here.
Healthy: the balance, the bit rate this cell type is built for. Measured on purified healthy cells, not chosen.

Right of healthy: more and more writing; the surface fills up toward the full surface, the black-hole side. Cancer sits here. It has not lost its identity; it is writing more than the cell can manage.
Right end, the ceiling (full surface): every identity site at a coin flip, 1 bit per site, the surface full. Derived.
misreading: A misreading to avoid. It was made more than three times while this gauge was being built, so it is printed on every report: the gauge reads writing on the surface, not holding energy; left is less writing, right is more. The floor is NOT the most a cell can hold, and cancer does NOT lose its identity. Below the floor the bit rate is too low to maintain the cell; cancer moves right, toward the full surface.

forbidden._rule: CANON/gauge_words.py refuses these on every presentation surface unless a negation (not, never, no longer, retired, wrong) stands just before them
